title: Buttery Cox Apple Soup
description: A simple French-inspired soup blending the sweetness of cox apples and buttery goodness.
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add kissed onions and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add cox apples and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Using an immersion blender, puree the soup until smooth.
Return pot to heat and simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
